description: This file defines a PHP class named 'StudioBrowser' responsible for loading module data and providing a node structure for the module browser interface within SuiteCRM, a fork of SugarCRM. It interacts with module metadata, checks user permissions, and manages module lists.

classes.name: StudioBrowser
classes.description: A class that manages loading modules and generating nodes for the module browser in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: loadModules
methods.description: Loads modules the current user has developer access to by reading the modules directory and checking metadata and user permissions.

methods.name: loadRelatableModules
methods.description: Loads modules that have metadata but may not be accessible as developer modules, for relating purposes.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Returns a sorted array of nodes representing modules by loading modules and aggregating their nodes.
